title: Improving Semantic Segmentation via Decoupled Body and Edge Supervision
mechanism: Splits features into a body part (made consistent by learned flow warping) and an edge part, each with its own supervision on sampled body and edge pixels.
adaptation: Apply to inactive and the cell-structure classes (blob interiors with sharp edges). Crack stays on the normal head because it is all edge.
min_experiment: Arm: house + body/edge decoupled decoder. Baseline: house. Metrics: inactive IoU (CV), border and material IoU. Kill if the inactive CV gain is < 0.02 and mIoU_rob gain is < 0.01.
evidence: R: Cityscapes 83.7 mIoU with fine annotations only; also CamVid, KITTI, BDD.
